Funding
Graduate Funding
Support Throughout Your Degree Program
Many AME graduate students receive teaching and research assistantships that pay tuition and a stipend. Also available to help you attain your goals are fellowships and scholarships as well as traineeships and student worker positions.
Teaching and Research Assistantships
Access details about AME teaching and research assistantships through the following resources:
MS and PhD (PDF) handbook for AME graduate students
U of A Graduate College GA Manual
AME application for teaching assistantships (PDF), graderships, and graduate tuition scholarships
Scholarships and Fellowships
These resources simplify finding, applying for and managing fellowships and scholarships:
Graduate College search for funding
Graduate funding programs for everyone
Scholarship Universe, U of A online database and search tool
Office of Fellowships support for finding external funding
U of A Engineering’s deadline-driven list
Contact: Stephanie Amado, samado@arizona.edu
